title: Mosslight
shortDescription: A quiet journey through an overgrown world, where every path hides a little wonder.
description:
Mosslight is a small, atmospheric pixel-art platform adventure set in a forgotten woodland. Explore misty clearings, discover glowing caves and follow the traces of a world slowly being reclaimed by nature.

This is a fictional sample release created to demonstrate the Frokyte Games website. It is not an actual published game.
releaseNotes: Download archive contains a readme only; no playable build is included.
demoNotice: Website demonstration only: this fictional sample release is not a playable game. The download is a small information archive, not a game build.
